# Zed Gnome

> Build drum kits for the Teenage Engineering OP-Z in the browser: 24 sounds, 12 seconds, written straight to its disk.

- A drum kit puts a sound on each key, for tracks 1 to 4. A synth sample mode makes one sound played at every key's pitch, for tracks 5 to 8.
- Writing to the OP-Z needs Chrome or Edge, with the OP-Z in content mode (hold the track button while switching it on). The .aif can also be downloaded and copied by hand.
- The keys can be played from a MIDI keyboard, or from the OP-Z over USB.

## Page

- [Zed Gnome](https://zedgnome.stephen8n.com/)
